title: The Astral Nexus
description:
Adds blocks and some anomalies, inspired by Lobotomy Corporation and SCP

Work in progress
body:
# **THE ASTRAL NEXUS**
A mod inspired by SCP and Lobotomy Corporation, aimed at adding both useful and dangerous anomalies into your world, such anomalies will not spawn naturally, and have to be summoned into your world, creating a peaceful style gameplay, where you can choose what to add.

Adds some blocks, such as tiles and nexus carpet.

### Anomalies
- θ7 - The Crystalline Rot
- α14 - The Super Evil Liquid That Destroys Stuff
- α14θ7 - Aetherblade
